theorems.name: Submission.dimred_mbl_pfi_bilipschitz_partition
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (H : Euclid n → Euclid P) (B : Set (Euclid n)), MeasurableSet B → (∀ a ∈ B, DifferentiableAt ℝ H a ∧ Injective (fderiv ℝ H a)) → ∃ (C : ℕ → Set (Euclid n)) (m : ℕ → ℝ), (∀ l, MeasurableSet (C l)) ∧ Pairwise (fun k l => Disjoint (C k) (C l)) ∧ (⋃ l, C l) = B ∧ (∀ l, 0 < m l) ∧ ∀ l, ∀ a ∈ C l, ∀ a' ∈ C l, m l * ‖a - a'‖ ≤ ‖H a - H a'‖
